_comment: The single source of truth for how an INCOMPLETE SEEDING is described to
the operator, shared by BOTH language implementations:
internal/helper/seed_warnings.go SeedGapDiagnosis (which every server-side
refusal quotes: the draw, PUT /competitions/:id/seeds, tournament import)
and web-mobile/js/admin_helpers.jsx seedGapDiagnosis (which blocks the draw
controls before any request is made).
THE CONTRACT: the diagnosis NAMES THE NUMBERS the operator has to go and
type, and stops there. It carries no remedy, because the remedy differs by
boundary ("generate the draw again" / "send the complete seeding" / which
tab to open) while the fault does not. `missing` is every rank below the
highest one set; the highest is named too, since it is the reason the rest
are required at all.
"" means NOT A GAP, and the empty cases below are the load-bearing half of
the table. A duplicate rank and a rank of 0 are also refused, but by rules
the validator already states precisely; a caller must pass those words
through rather than invent a missing rank for them.
Why a shared file rather than each suite restating the strings: changing
one language AND its own tests together is the realistic drift, and two
independent tables both stay green through it. Editing this file fails the
OTHER language's suite immediately, so an operator can never be given two
different accounts of the same half-typed seeding.
Go half: TestSeedGapDiagnosis_GoldenTable in seed_warnings_test.go.
JS half: web-mobile/js/__tests__/seed_gap.test.jsx.

cases.why: no seeds at all is a valid seeding, not a gap
order of entry is not order of rank; the set is what counts
typing seed 4 first, the state the seeding panel saves mid-entry
cases.diagnosis: Seeding is incomplete: seed ranks 1, 2 and 3 have not been set, but rank 4 has.

cases.why: one rank skipped: singular verb and no list separator
cases.diagnosis: Seeding is incomplete: seed rank 2 has not been set, but rank 3 has.

cases.why: two missing ranks join with 'and', never a trailing comma
cases.diagnosis: Seeding is incomplete: seed ranks 2 and 3 have not been set, but rank 4 has.

cases.why: three or more: commas then 'and' before the last
cases.diagnosis: Seeding is incomplete: seed ranks 1, 3, 4 and 5 have not been set, but rank 6 has.

cases.why: double digits: the highest rank is named as typed
cases.diagnosis: Seeding is incomplete: seed ranks 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 have not been set, but rank 12 has.

cases.why: a duplicate is not a gap: the validator's own words are used instead
rank 0 is not a gap either, even though 0 makes 1 look present
a negative rank is refused by the same rule as 0
